'''''Ord Mantell Travel Advertisement''''' was the name of an advertising [[Painting/Legends|poster]] that was available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] shortly following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a pivotal engagement during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The poster was meant to lure tourists to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. The advertisement depicted a large building with spires atop a [[Mountain/Legends|hill]]. [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text, the [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]] of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], at the bottom of the poster read "Ord Mantell."

==Description==
The [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] advertisement showed a winding street with three sets of lamps set far apart from each other. The street led up a [[Mountain/Legends|hill]], where a large building with a spire was positioned. It was [[Color/Legends|colored]] in various shades of blue, brown, and white. Text at the bottom of the poster, written in the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]], [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]], read "Ord Mantell."<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
''Ord Mantell Travel Advertisement'' was an advertising [[Painting|poster]] that was available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], following the conclusion of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a crucial engagement in the conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] known as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The purpose of the poster was to convince travelers and tourists to visit Ord Mantell, a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Ord Mantell Travel Advertisement'' was a decorative item in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', which was released to the public on [[June 26]], [[2003]].<ref name="SWG" /> The game shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players could obtain the poster as a [[W:c:swg:Loot card|loot item]] from the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' expansion set ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]''. [[Tatooine Travel Advertisement|Several]] [[Mustafar Travel Advertisement|other]] [[Hoth Travel Advertisement|similarly]] themed advertisement posters were available through the trading card game. Once obtained, the player could use the poster as decoration in a personal structure.<ref name="SWG" /> A similar building can be seen in ''[[Streets of Ord Mantell]]'', a painting of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]]&mdash;a [[City/Legends|city]] on Ord Mantell&mdash;by [[Chris Trevas]].<ref name="INSDR">{{InsiderCite|36|The Unseen Planets of Star Wars|The Unseen Planets of ''Star Wars''}}</ref>
